name: spreadsheetClearCell
description: Clears the contents of a single cell in the active sheet of a spreadsheet workbook. Rows and columns are 1-based (row 1, column 1 = cell A1). The fluent member form is clearCell(row, column).

params.name: row
params.description: 1-based row index of the cell to clear.

params.name: column
params.description: 1-based column index of the cell to clear.

examples.title: Clear cell A1
examples.description: Remove the value previously written to row 1, column 1.
